answer: Equivocation-proof bonds stop fake identities. Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and files one fable naming its willow plot and pearl task. Anyone proving one key behind two filings, or two identities on one willow plot, burns both bonds. Filing costs 40+6(k-1) each; 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. A rented fable fails: a shared pearl tag is itself the proof. Honest agents file once, pay 40, keep the bond.
